7:00 P.M.
NOTICE: A copy of the following public hearing staff reports and Initial Studies, if applicable, for the Planning Commission projects will be available for review during regular working hours of 7:00 a.m. to 5:30 p.m., Monday - Thursday at the Planning Division and during regular hours of the Azusa City Library. Any questions regarding any agenda item may be answered by the Planning Division at (626) 812-5017. The Planning Commission Meetings are held at 7:00 p.m. in the Azusa Civic Auditorium at 213 East Foothill Boulevard, Azusa, California.

General Plan Amendment GPA 2010-01, Zone Change Z 2009-01, Zoning Code Amendment 230, Use Permit UP 2010-01, Use Permit UP 2010-04, Use Permit UP - 2010-05, Variance V 2010-02, Variance V 2010-04, Design Review DR 2009-01 (Continued from Planning Commission Meeting of May 11, 2011,where Public Hearing was closed). Applicant: Waste Management
APN: 8615-016-006, 8615-007-017, 8615-007-018, 8615-008-035
Address: 1501 W. Gladstone Street, Azusa, CA 91702
A request to allow the construction and operation of a material recovery facility (MRF) and transfer station (TS). The application includes a General Plan Amendment and Zone Change to allow the proposed use, a Zoning Code Amendment and Use Permit to allow 24 hour operations; Use permits for the MRF/TS, for reduced parking; Variance for additional fence height, for additional building height and to modify development standards for the processing facility; and a Design Review for the construction of the facility. A draft Environmental Impact Report is being prepared for the project.

APN: 8625-002-009/ 010/ 011 012/ 013, 8625-002-026/027, Tracts 54057-13, 18 and 20.
A request for approval of a Design Review application to construct 66 detached single-family homes distributed between Tracts 54057-13, 18, and 20, for the newly named "Botanika" district of Rosedale within the Monrovia Specific Plan area.
Due to necessary site plan revisions staff is requesting this item be continued to the Planning Commission meeting of June 15, 2011.
